hero.title: The Estate
hero.subtitle: More than 2,500 years of history in a unique rural setting in Castilla-La Mancha, between Villamanrique and the heart of La Mancha.

blocks.title: A melting pot of cultures
paragraphs: Set in the province of Ciudad Real, close to the village of Villamanrique, in Campos de Montiel — a natural and historic region of La Mancha.

A unique place whose history reaches back more than 2,500 years BC. Here you can see prehistoric remains and traces of the peoples who passed through, among them Iberians, Romans, Visigoths and Arabs.

blocks.title: Spaces and services
paragraphs: The estate sleeps a maximum of 16 adults (8 bungalows) and offers dining, an outdoor pool, a library lounge, a fireplace, an outdoor porch and camp kitchens.
A private, versatile setting: ideal for couples, family stays, corporate retreats, film shoots and small events in the open air.

calerilla.title: La Calerilla
paragraphs: Within Los Collados de San Miguel, La Calerilla is our shooting ground, devoted to the tradition of red-legged partridge walked-up, in the natural landscape of Campos de Montiel.
From October to February we organise shooting days that can be combined with bungalow accommodation and our traditional La Mancha cuisine.
